caption: The video captures an elevated, near-static view of a broad waterfall, where a rocky lip cuts diagonally across the frame and thick curtains of white water plunge into shadow. To the upper right, a calm river drifts toward the brink among vegetated islets and dark rocks, while a sun glint flickers on the open water near the top center. The falling columns churn continuously, their streaks and froth reconfiguring frame to frame even as the curtain positions remain fixed. At the brink, the bright frothy crest spills over the edge and reforms, so the white band fluctuates in texture. On the left, a tall bank of pale spray hangs over the cliff, wavering in density and shape as it thins and thickens. The cliff outline, river rocks, and vegetation hold their positions, keeping the scene's structure persistent while water and mist keep moving.
